submit_pens_comparison.description: Plateau ensemble size comparison for EN+NMC pipeline. Tests n_plateau=50 vs n_plateau=80 (the maximum number of qualifying combinations).
submit_pens_comparison.note: Originally tested 50, 200, and unlimited. Both 200 and unlimited resolved to n_plateau=80 (only 80 qualifying combinations exist), so merged into single p80 variant. Original en_nmc_pens uses n_plateau=15.
